goals.objective: Determine whether the CSE evidence and institutional claims are audit-ready.
success_conditions: All mandatory evidence types are accounted for.
Blocking integrity findings are resolved or formally disclosed.
Every mapped document remains traceable to its source.
A final defensibility decision is produced.

constraints: Do not modify original evidence files.
goals.objective: Acquire and register all available evidence in the approved source scope.
success_conditions: Every discoverable supported file is registered or explicitly skipped.
Every registered file has a checksum and immutable source reference.

constraints: Do not modify original evidence files.
failure_conditions: No evidence item can be interpreted.
goals.objective: Extract, classify, and map every registered evidence item.
success_conditions: Every processable item has an extraction state and document type.
Every item has a requirement mapping or an explicit unresolved state.

constraints: Do not modify original evidence files.
failure_conditions: Evidence cannot be bundled or checked.
goals.objective: Verify evidence integrity, sufficiency, and requirement defensibility.
success_conditions: All applicable deterministic rules are executed.
Blocking findings and evidence gaps are explicitly disclosed.
A defensibility state is produced.

constraints: Do not modify original evidence files.
failure_conditions: No claim decision can be produced.
goals.objective: Validate institutional claims at atomic level using supporting and counter-evidence.
success_conditions: Every atomic claim has a validation state and evidence references.
Contradictions are resolved or explicitly disclosed.
A defensible claim decision and lineage are produced.

constraints: Do not modify original evidence files.
failure_conditions: Blocking gaps lack actionable resolution plans.
goals.objective: Convert claim and integrity failures into a prioritized resolution and readiness programme.
success_conditions: Every unresolved finding is represented by one normalized gap.
Every gap has strategies, closure evidence, and dependencies.
Readiness impact and priority are calculated.

constraints: Do not modify original evidence files.
failure_conditions: A task is assigned without authorization or independent approval.
goals.objective: Recommend authorized primary, backup, approval, and escalation responsibility for every resolution gap.
success_conditions: Every gap has an assignment recommendation or formal unresolved state.
Permissions, workload, department, and conflicts are checked.
Human approval requirements and escalation paths are explicit.

constraints: Do not modify original evidence files.
failure_conditions: A task is activated without approval or an authorized owner.
goals.objective: Convert governed ownership and resolution recommendations into policy-controlled tasks and communications.
success_conditions: Every canonical issue has a task decision.
Unapproved work remains paused.
Communication records use least-disclosure scope.

constraints: Do not modify original evidence files.
failure_conditions: A gap is marked resolved without closure evidence.
goals.objective: Evaluate submitted closure evidence through targeted revalidation and issue lifecycle transitions.
success_conditions: Submitted evidence alone does not close any issue.
Closure decisions require registration, classification, integrity, claim, and policy checks.
Resolved, rejected, reopened, or waiting states are explicit.

constraints: Do not modify original evidence files.
failure_conditions: A package includes rejected or missing evidence.
goals.objective: Generate a reproducible draft audit package manifest with eligibility, lineage, exclusions, and warnings.
success_conditions: Package scope is frozen.
Only eligible evidence is included.
Manifest, checksums, lineage, exclusions, and unresolved warnings are present.

constraints: Do not modify original evidence files.
failure_conditions: The package passes despite unsupported material claims.
goals.objective: Challenge the draft package as a skeptical internal auditor before human approval.
success_conditions: Every material claim is challenged.
Package references are tested.
Omissions, reuse risks, and reviewer friction are scored.
A quality status and correction route are produced.
